In a study for Lightspeed, AI assistants picked a national chain over a smaller retailer up to 94% of the time when answering from training data alone. When the researchers added the word independent to matched prompts, the share going to large chains dropped from about 44% to as little as 9%.

So if customers choose you because you're independent, specialist or local, that word needs to be in plain text wherever an assistant reads about you. Homepage, product copy, Google Business Profile, Merchant Center feed.

To see whether it's working, give your AI 30 product-level prompts, each in a plain and a paired version, and have it run them monthly and log which retailers each assistant names.

The podcast voices are AI-generated. Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/ai-shopping-assistants-favour-big-retailers/
clips.text: Vaer AI re-ran matched prompts with the word independent added, and the share going to large chains dropped from about forty-four per cent to as little as nine. One word. One word. So the way shoppers describe what they want changes which retailers get considered. That makes it a category entry point problem, the needs and moments that bring someone to buy. If customers choose you because you're independent, specialist, local or expert-led, that word has to be in plain text wherever an assistant reads about you. Homepage, about page, product copy, your Google Business Profile, your Merchant Center feed. Not tucked into a logo.

Your AI can run 30 shopping prompts through ChatGPT and Google every month and log who gets named.

A study Lightspeed published on 29 September found local shops were the top AI pick in about a third of broad category searches, and as little as one in ten once the shopper named a specific product.

Our view is that challenger retailers and DTC brands should stop treating AI visibility as one score and track it product by product.

Start by giving your AI your 10 best sellers. It hands back 30 prompts phrased the way a shopper would ask, plus a paired version of each with your attribute added, independent or specialist. Then set it to run them monthly in ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews.

The prompts are in the show notes.

You can look healthy on broad category prompts and still vanish at the point of purchase. So, get AI on this. What's the first job? Get AI on writing your test prompts.
